newsitem.title: USA: Daniel Industries, Bettis to merge.
newsitem.headline: Daniel Industries, Bettis to merge.

text.p: Daniel Industries Inc and Bettis Corp said jointly on Monday the two companies had signed a definitive agreement to merge.

Bettis stockholders will receive 0.58 shares of Daniel Industries for each share held, a ratio which is fixed and which will not be adjusted for fluctuations in stock price, the two companies said in a press release.
Once the merger is complete, Daniel Industries will have about 17.1 million shares outstanding, of which former Bettis stockholders will own about 29 percent.

The merger is subject to due diligence review and approval from regulatory agencies and the shareholders of both companies. It is expected to close before December 31 and is intended to be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
The board of directors of Daniel Industries will consist of nine members after the merger is complete, seven of whom are currently directors of Daniel Industries.
Daniel Industries chairman Ronald Lassiter and W.A. Griffin, president and chief executive, will retain their posts.
W. Todd Bratton, currently president and CEO of Bettis, will become executive vice-president of Daniel Industries, the two companies said.
Shares of Bettis closed on Monday unchanged at $6-7/8, while Daniel Industries stock lost 1/8 to settle at $13.
